description: Dept. of Local Government North Central Province -  Appointment  of  Mr. G. R. Gamlath as a Deputy Mayor for Polonnaruwa MC
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically announces the declaration of a Deputy Mayor for a Local Government Authority (Polonnaruwa Municipal Council) under Section 66 C(I) of the Local Government Elections Ordinance. The content is directly related to electoral processes and the formal declaration of an elected official's name following local government elections, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
